_comment: Example MCP server config for Claude Code. Drop into ~/.claude/mcp_servers.json (or merge with existing). Exposes siimply /api/v1/* endpoints to Claude so you can say 'create a draft tweet for Friday' and Claude handles the API call.

siimply._alternative_comment: If you'd rather write a small custom MCP server, see the marketing-on-autopilot guide for a Node.js template. The server should expose tools for: list_accounts, create_draft, generate_caption, list_scheduled_posts.
